silhouette.description: What kind of footwear this is, described only from its shape. e.g. 'high-top leather sneaker', 'rubber rain boot', 'slide sandal'.

brand.description: Brand name in English. Null unless a logo, wordmark, or an unmistakable brand-specific design element is actually visible.

modelName.description: Model name in English. Null unless the silhouette and visible design details identify a specific model.

color.description: Main colorway in English, as seen. Do not use official colorway names unless printed on a visible label.

candidates.description: Alternative brand/model readings, most likely first. Empty when the identification is unambiguous.

evidence.description: One entry for every non-null field above. A field without evidence must be null.

imageIndex.description: 0-based index of the image this was seen in.

observedText.description: Text literally readable in the image. Null when the evidence is not text.

observation.description: In Korean, one sentence stating what is visible. Describe only what is in the image.

sourceChunkId.description: Always null. Reserved for citing reference data supplied in the prompt.

unreadable.description: Fields left null, with the reason. In Korean.
